text:
Aisha (Docs): Heads up—I'm drafting the relnotes for next week's site push. Main items: embed streaming tweak, snippet migration, plus a few link-orphan issues I found while QA. Will open a PR in ~30m.

Ben (SDK): thanks — can you list the orphaned snippets? I can sweep the SDK examples for references.

Aisha (Docs): quick list in the PR description but highlights:
- examples/guides/embeddings/fast-start.md references `snippet:embed-async` but that snippet was deleted in migration.
- snippets/tutorials/llm-chat/step-3.rst has an anchor `#streaming-quirks` that 404s.

Cara (I18N): FYI some of the localized pages still point to the old snippet paths. I ran a grep across `i18n/*/docs` and got a handful. I'll paste results in the PR.

Ben (SDK): perfect. If you include the snippet IDs I can add a test in the snippet-checker CI job to fail on references that don't resolve.

Ethan (Eng): small heads up — the streaming change mentioned is a behavior change for partial chunking when `max_tokens` is low. Causes a short trailing token split. We're adding a note under Known Issues.

Aisha (Docs): yes, want to call it out explicitly: "Known issue: embed streaming may drop the final token when max_tokens < 8 in rare cases". Can someone confirm wording?

Marco (Docs): wording LGTM but add repro steps and the relevant SDK snippet (so support can triage quickly).

Ben (SDK): repro idea: run `python examples/embedding_stream_repro.py --prompt-length 6` on the canary model and observe trailing token mismatch. I'll add the snippet: 
```python
# examples/embedding_stream_repro.py
from redwood import Client

c = Client()
print(c.embed_stream("short prompt", max_tokens=6))
```

Cara (I18N): for translations, should we add a short "Known issues" anchor on the english page and reference that from the localized pages? Less duplication.

Aisha (Docs): good call. I'll add `#known-issues-v0-9-4` to the relnotes and link localizations to it.

DevBot: PR opened by Aisha: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321> — title: "Relnotes v0.9.4: streaming fixes, snippet migration, known issues"

Ben (SDK): on it — starting a quick review. I'll flag snippet orphan IDs as TODOs in the PR so we can track fixes.

Ethan (Eng): Marco/Cara — if QA needs a canary deploy to confirm the repro, ping me; I can spin up a small canary in staging.

Marco (Docs): will do. Also found 2 internal links in the changelog that point to `docs:embed-api#examples` but the target moved to `docs:embed-api#examples-v2`. I'll add redirect notes in the PR.

Aisha (Docs): thanks — for the relnotes summary I want 3 bullets and 1 inline code snippet example for each major change. Keep it short for the newsletter.

Ben (SDK): quick Q — should we mark the embed streaming behavior as "behavioral change" or "known issue"? It'll be fixed in the next patch but might break some integrations.

Ethan (Eng): label it as "Known issue (regression in canary)" + workaround: "set max_tokens >= 8 or use stable model until patch ships".

Aisha (Docs): ok I'll write: "Known issue: short prompts + streaming may omit final token. Workaround: set max_tokens >= 8 or use non-canary models."

DevBot: CI status for PR #4321 — docs/lint: passing, snippet-check: failing (2 missing refs), link-check: failing (1 404)

Ben (SDK): I'll push a tiny PR to add stub snippets for the 2 missing refs while we update the canonical examples. Keeps snippet-check green.

Cara (I18N): I've started a sweep of localized pages and pushed a branch with fixes for the anchor links — will open a PR after Aisha's relnotes are merged so I can point to the final anchor name.

Marco (Docs): reminder — include a short note in the relnotes about rolling back the canary if we see errors in production. Add contact: `#eng-oncall` for immediate rollback.

Aisha (Docs): added. Draft pushed to PR body. If you have copy edits, leave comments on the PR rather than in-thread. Planning to cut the announce at 10am PT Tues.

Ben (SDK): leaving inline comments now. :thumbsup:

Ethan (Eng): will stand by for canary test.

DevBot: PR #4321 updated by Ben — snippet stubs added. CI: all green.

Aisha (Docs): excellent. Merging in 10m unless objections.

Cara (I18N): no objections from localization side.

Marco (Docs): go for it.

Aisha (Docs): merged. I'll post the announce draft to #product once release is live and drop a short blurb for the newsletter. Thanks team! :party-parrot:
